title: sesleria rigida subsp. achtarovii
intro: Sesleria rigida subsp. achtarovii, commonly known as Achtarov's fescue, is a plant species within the Poaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which may include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Sesleria rigida subsp. achtarovii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which have been found to include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
